battle_phases.completion_condition: At second 56, both medics and all opening positions are established without leaks or missing survival-dependent grants.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A lost interceptor or missed grant breaks subsequent survival and deployment handoffs; later DP accumulation cannot repair the earlier leak.
battle_phases.goal: Preserve the central economy while establishing four hostile interception responsibilities.
handoff_requirements: Ansel deploys at second 44 and Hibiscus at second 56.
Opening runner kills and surviving interceptor HP must be verified independently of static deployment legality.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla provide mutual central damage and blocking.
Lancet supports lower central and lower outer patients.

Noir Corne absorbs lower runner pressure until the planned replacement.
survival_dependencies: Fang survives through the second automatic grant.
Vanilla survives both early manual grants.
Kroos contributes sufficient hostile damage before Friston exhausts his HP.

battle_phases.completion_condition: By second 105, both eastern restraints and the upper western restraint are destroyed, Steward is sustained, and Popukar has resumed upper outer interception.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An uncleared eastern lower restraint recreates prolonged artillery exposure; incomplete upper clearance or a surviving opening hostile invalidates the protection and interception transitions.
battle_phases.goal: Open safe civilian routes and commit artillery damage without sacrificing interception continuity.

battle_phases.start_condition: Opening positions and both medics remain active at second 56.
survival_dependencies: Plume survives residual opening combat and restraint work.
Friston remains alive until his quiet-interval withdrawal.
Both medics survive artillery pressure and maintain assigned coverage.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Surviving artillery invalidates the central damage transfer and final release safety; civilian death or any leak permanently fails project acceptance.

handoff_requirements: Verify upper arrival and lower civilian position as separate objective observations.

Stop counting vanguard income after each retirement.

Plume's skill clears lower officers without allowing pursuit of the civilian.
Spot and Midnight assume central blocking.

battle_phases.start_condition: Popukar is deployed and the lower civilian has spawned.
survival_dependencies: Civilian transit must precede officer proximity; ordinary operators cannot shield it through blocking.
Steward and both medics must survive until artillery destruction.
Hibiscus must sustain Midnight through initial armor contact.

battle_phases.completion_condition: After the second-211 final modeled spawn, both outer queues are empty and upper retirement is safe by second 235.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unresolved outer queue makes restraint release unsafe; central collapse can still cause leaks after the spawn schedule ends.
battle_phases.goal: Clear final officers, runners and armor without abandoning either outer interception line.
handoff_requirements: Verify the final upper outer kill before Popukar retires.
Maintain lower interception while the civilian remains restrained westward.
responsibilities: Lava supplies central arts while Midnight maintains lower blocking and upper assistance.

Popukar and Plume finish their complete outer schedules.

survival_dependencies: No unsupported splash, healing talent or Spot skill is required.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both expected civilians have safely arrived, no protected target has died, spawns are exhausted, no active enemies remain, zero leaks occurred and remaining_life is positive.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unreleased or unarrived civilian leaves the objective incomplete; any leak or protected-target death rejects the plan even if remaining hostiles are eventually killed.

Require all victory and project acceptance predicates together.

Spot, Midnight, Lava and both full medics continue central clearance.

survival_dependencies: Durin's position must be free of artillery and hostile exposure.
Central blocking and healing persist until actual exhaustion, not a guessed end frame.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward damages artillery throughout its eastern vertical segment. Both medics must survive and sustain him until destruction before the frame-5250 handoff.
Kroos destroys restraint #3, Melantha destroys #1, and the upper civilian safely reaches its objective before the artillery's western return.
Fang hands upper central blocking to Spot. Midnight's downward range and Lava supply clearance; Ansel and Hibiscus sustain the position.
Vanilla hands lower central blocking to Midnight. Hibiscus remains the principal late healer; Lava assists against armor without assumed splash.
Kroos and Friston clear the opening upper outer hostiles. Popukar resumes interception before paired officers and stays through the final upper outer kill.
Noir Corne absorbs opening pressure; Plume finishes survivors, clears the eastern restraint and intercepts later officers. Lancet supplies continuing healing.

Plume destroys restraint #4 before civilian arrival. The civilian passes the interception line during its quiet interval, waits at western restraint #2, and is released by Durin after artillery destruction and hostile isolation.

formation_structure.clearance: Spot, Midnight and Lava retain the central defense through late armor. Durin clears the final restraint while all remaining interception duties stay staffed.
formation_structure.medical: Ansel covers upper outer, upper central and Steward. Hibiscus covers both central positions, Ansel and Steward. Their separation from Steward avoids the former adjacent medic-caster pairing, but artillery target selection remains a survival uncertainty.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla face each other across adjacent central lanes. Lancet heals Vanilla and the lower outer position. Kroos covers Friston's upper interception tile and the upper eastern restraint.
formation_structure.outer: Friston bridges to Popukar through a scheduled quiet interval. Noir Corne hands the lower lane to Plume after absorbing most opening runner damage. Lancet remains responsible for Plume.
formation_structure.protection: Kroos releases the upper eastern restraint; Melantha releases its western restraint. Plume releases the lower eastern restraint before civilian arrival. The lower western restraint intentionally remains until hostile isolation.

formation_transitions.transition: Retreat Noir Corne before deploying Plume on [6,5]; surviving runner and officer damage transfers to Plume with Lancet retained.
Withdraw Kroos only after upper eastern restraint destruction has been recorded.
Use Kroos's released slot for Melantha's western upper clearance.
Friston yields his slot to Steward during the upper outer spawn gap; the opening upper runner and officer must already be dead.
Melantha yields her slot to Popukar after western upper restraint destruction; upper outer blocking resumes before the paired officers arrive.
Replace Fang with Spot before armor pressure; cease crediting Fang's future DP.
Replace Vanilla with Midnight after the final scheduled Vanilla skill has completed.
Steward yields his slot to Lava only after artillery destruction; surviving artillery invalidates this handoff.
After upper outer clearance, Popukar yields his slot to Durin for final protected-target release.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator is catalog-listed, rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true. All deployment tiles are supplied deployable terrain; never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
At most eight operators are deployed. Every occupied-tile replacement retreats its incumbent first; no robot deployment-limit exception is assumed.
Both central vanguards survive their credited grants. The opening upper outer runner dies before Friston's unsupported endurance is exhausted; Kroos target diversion can falsify this bridge.
Use natural DP plus the explicitly survival-dependent vanguard grants only. No refund, kill DP, unsupported talent DP or future grant repairs a missed deployment.
Ansel and Hibiscus must both be deployed and alive before Steward's commitment. Their healing cannot be credited after death or assumed to override unknown target selection.

Destroy upper restraint #3 before Kroos retires, upper #1 before Melantha retires, and lower #4 before the 101-second civilian spawn. Verify lower civilian transit west of the interceptor before later officers threaten it within 1.2.
Artillery must be dead before Steward retires. Upper outer hostiles must be exhausted before Popukar retires. Missing gates are survival or clearance failures, not automatic alternate actions.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Only verified roadblock restraint and destruction govern civilian release; civilian deaths are never counted as hostile kills.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe protected-target arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Mutual central coverage must preserve both vanguards. Kroos must prevent Friston's opening runner from becoming a fatal prolonged duel. Establish Ansel at 44 seconds and Hibiscus at 56 seconds.
Complete eastern releases, transfer lower interception to supported Plume, clear the western upper restraint and establish dual-healed artillery damage.
Record upper safe arrival and lower westward transit; restore upper outer blocking, replace central vanguards and destroy artillery before its caster handoff.
Lava and Midnight clear central armor while both outer interceptors finish all scheduled officers. The final modeled spawn at 211 seconds does not itself authorize retirement.
Durin releases the remaining civilian after verified isolation. Retain central blocking and healing until both safe arrivals and complete hostile exhaustion are recorded.

Supported ATK enhancement; count one attacked target, with no inferred centurion multi-target damage.

Deployment supplies 30 SP; activate after another 10 seconds, then include active-SP pauses. Count single-target arts damage only.
Use supported automatic double shots without random critical-hit credit or prescribed target ordering.
Use supported attack-SP enhanced hits without talent ATK or highest-defense targeting assumptions.
Ordinary blocking and attacks only; unsupported healing mode is excluded.
Credit supported deployment recovery to eligible allies and ordinary single-target healing; do not assume civilian healing.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Replace independent central duels with mutual vanguard coverage, add inexpensive opening healing, and establish both full medics before committing the artillery caster. Kroos supports the upper bridge and clears its eastern restraint; supported Plume replaces the lower interceptor and clears the lower eastern restraint before the second civilian arrives. Release the upper western restraint during the quiet interval, hold the lower civilian safely at its western restraint, and clear that restraint after hostile isolation. Every survival, clearance and artillery handoff remains a testable prerequisite.

unknown_dependencies.dependency: Roadblock durability and ordinary target selection were not independently inspected.
unknown_dependencies.impact: The three early clearance deadlines are hypotheses requiring event verification.

unknown_dependencies.dependency: Artillery targeting and complete splash geometry remain unknown.
unknown_dependencies.impact: Dual medical coverage is an assigned survival responsibility, not proof that every possible impact pattern is sustainable.

revised_stage_understanding.causal_revision: The prior economy failed because its operators did not survive their duties. This revision changes opening attack coverage, adds early lower healing, advances full medical establishment and replaces the unsupported lower clearance duel with a continuously healed interceptor.
revised_stage_understanding.evidence_limit: Read-only shell inspection could not start because of the local sandbox socket-directory error. No files were changed, no simulation was run and no other AI provider was invoked.

fact_domains.GameData: Catalog legality, source stats, ranges, skills, terrain and routes.
fact_domains.UNKNOWN: Exact client timing and target priority, complete splash geometry, roadblock durability not separately inspected, and ordinary WALK navigation changes from active devices.
fact_domains.current_model: 30-FPS action clock, natural DP, supported skill execution, corrected neutral and objective behavior, and the supplied spawn schedule.

revised_stage_understanding.protection_structure: Upper evacuation uses two distinct clearance assignments. Lower protection releases the eastern restraint early and deliberately retains the western restraint until artillery destruction and hostile isolation.

falsifiers: Upper opening runner survives beyond the bridge endurance window.
Either full medic cannot deploy on schedule because its economic source died.
Lower eastern restraint remains active at civilian spawn.
Artillery survives the scheduled caster withdrawal.
Either civilian fails to reach its objective safely.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Mutual central attacks, early lower healing and Kroos-supported upper bridging preserve the opening economy long enough to establish both medics. Supported lower restraint clearance then removes prolonged civilian exposure, while sustained dual-healed Steward damage permits the central arts handoff.

revised_tactical_requirements.economy: Every credited skill grant requires its source operator to remain alive and deployed. A missing grant diagnoses failed survival or handoff responsibility.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Verify central mutual coverage preserves both vanguards and Kroos prevents upper bridge exhaustion.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Verify destruction of each assigned restraint and actual civilian transit; neither medic coverage nor a declared release proves safe arrival.
revised_tactical_requirements.terminal: Continue blocking, healing and clearance beyond the last spawn until all acceptance predicates hold.
revised_tactical_requirements.validation_status: One untested full-stage candidate; arithmetic and roster structure do not establish tactical success.

changed_responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla face each other and share central attack coverage instead of fighting independent forward duels.
Lancet enters during the opening and retains lower interceptor healing rather than arriving after the lower defense has already failed.
Kroos supports Friston from a tile covering both the upper interception point and eastern restraint.
Plume inherits a damaged opening queue with continuing healing and must clear the lower eastern restraint before civilian spawn.
Steward deploys only after both full medics are established, and his retirement requires actual artillery destruction.
The lower western restraint remains a deliberate holding point until terminal hostile isolation and Durin clearance.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the Kroos-supported upper bridge hypothesis. Inspect whether restraint targeting diverted damage or Friston exhausted his HP, then treat subsequent interception, healing and economic handoffs as unestablished rather than repairing the ledger or assuming later actions recover the loss.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: The revised opening supplies mutual central damage and dedicated upper ranged assistance before the former collapse interval. Earlier established medical coverage and continuously supported lower restraint work should preserve interception, avoid stationary lower civilian exposure and enable a complete artillery-to-central-clearance handoff.
